# @heswell/trading-schemas API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/api-reference.ts from the TypeScript source. Do not edit: run `bun run docs:api`. -->

The client entry of `@heswell/trading-schemas`: table definitions, enums, RPC contracts and validation, tick / lot maths. Shared by the UI, the servers and the in-browser engines. Overview: [schemas.md](../schemas.md), [package README](../../packages/trading-schemas/README.md).

Imports: `@heswell/trading-schemas`. 173 exports. Types are shown as written in the source; defaults come from `@default` tags or the component's destructuring defaults.

#### ORDER_STATUS_TRANSITIONS

*const* · [domain/orderStatus.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/domain/orderStatus.ts#L20)

Allowed OrdStatus transitions, shared by OMS (which enforces them) and UI
(which uses them to decide e.g. whether amend/cancel are offered).

Conventions:
- An order always starts in PENDING_NEW and is acknowledged (NEW) or
  REJECTED before any fill is reported.
- IOC/FOK remainders and DAY orders at session end become EXPIRED.
- A cancel/replace reject returns the order to its working status
  (NEW / PARTIALLY_FILLED / REPLACED).
- Fills may race a pending cancel/replace.
- REPLACED is a working status: the order was amended and remains live.
- FILLED, CANCELLED, REJECTED and EXPIRED are terminal.

This is only the transition table; the full reducer (quantities, exec
reports) lives in the OMS (Phase 2).

```ts
const ORDER_STATUS_TRANSITIONS: Readonly< Record<OrdStatus, readonly OrdStatus[]> >
```

#### TickBand

*interface* · [domain/ticks.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/domain/ticks.ts#L9)

Tick and lot utilities shared by the order ticket, price ladder, OMS
validation and exchange-sim quoting bots.

A tick schedule is either a flat tick size or price bands (as used by most
European venues), each band applying from `from` (inclusive) upwards.

| Member | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` | `number` |  | Lower price bound (inclusive) from which `tickSize` applies. |
| `tickSize` | `number` |  |  |

#### RpcName

*const* · [rpc/contracts.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/rpc/contracts.ts#L38)

RPC contracts. All trading RPCs are sent as RPC_REQUEST with
VIEWPORT_CONTEXT (any viewport on a table of the target module) and are
registered server-side with DefaultRpcHandler.registerRpc.

Params are flat (Vuu restricts RPC params to string | number | boolean).
Success: SUCCESS_RESULT with the typed `data` below.
Failure: ERROR_RESULT whose errorMessage is `"<RejectReason>: <text>"`
(see formatRpcError / parseRpcError).

```ts
const RpcName: Readonly<{ readonly CreateOrder: "createOrder"; readonly AmendOrder: "amendOrder"; readonly CancelOrder: "cancelOrder"; readonly CancelAll: "cancelAll"; readonly SetVolatility: "setVolatility"; readonly HaltInstrument: "haltInstrument"; readonly ResumeInstrument: "resumeInstrument"; readonly SetBotRate: "setBotRate"...
```
